topics.title: 5.2 Custom Hooks in Multi-File Architecture

codeStudio.title: Custom Hooks & Business Logic Separation
codeStudio.description:
Learn to extract stateful logic into a reusable custom Hook.

The goal is not to create a magical new React feature. A custom Hook is simply a JavaScript function whose name begins with `use` and that can call other Hooks. The Hook should hide reusable behavior while the component decides how to display it.

Flow:
App.jsx → useToggle(false) → [value, toggle]
                    ↓
              button + conditional UI

Important beginner rule: Hooks must be called at the top level of components or custom Hooks, not inside loops, conditions, or event handlers.
